products.title: Blue Hour Garden
products.description: A dusk-lit garden in layered blues and soft pinks, painted loosely with a palette knife and finished with fine brush details. Ready to hang.

products.title: Peony Morning
products.description: Wet-on-wet peonies that bleed into one another, painted on heavyweight cotton paper. Sent unframed in a protective sleeve.

products.title: Quiet Eucalyptus
products.description: A tall, calm study of eucalyptus sprigs in sage and grey-green. Painted on gallery-wrapped canvas, so it needs no frame.

products.title: Ocean Resin Earrings
products.description: Lightweight teardrop earrings with tiny dried flowers suspended in ocean-blue resin. Hypoallergenic hooks.

products.title: Pressed Petal Pendant
products.description: A keepsake pendant with real pressed petals preserved in clear resin. No two are the same.

products.title: Tide Pool Tray
products.description: A serving tray poured in swirling blues and whites with gold leaf. This one has found a home, but I can make something similar.

products.title: Wildflower Tee
products.description: A soft cotton tee with a trailing wildflower design painted by hand in fabric paint. Wash inside out, cold.

products.title: Blue Bloom Tee
products.description: A single oversized bloom across the chest in layered blues. Hand-painted in fabric paint on a relaxed-fit tee.

products.title: Sage Wave Coasters (set of 4)
products.description: Four heat-resistant resin coasters with sage-green waves and gold flecks, with a cork base. Colours can be customised.

products.title: Floral Resin Photo Frame
products.description: A keepsake frame with real flowers set into the resin border. Priced from ₹2,200 and made to order, so tell me your colours and the flowers you'd like.

products.title: Mini Me Clay Figurine
products.description: A tiny sculpted version of you, a loved one or a pet, made from a photo. Priced from ₹1,500, depending on detail.

products.title: Clay Fridge Magnet Set
products.description: Three hand-sculpted clay magnets: a bloom, a teacup and a tiny cottage. A small piece of art for the fridge.
